### <span class="imp imp-mid" title="Importance 6/10" aria-label="Importance 6 of 10">6</span> NASA Delays Boeing's Starliner Crewed Missions to 2028, May Require New Rocket
NASA announced that Boeing's Starliner spacecraft will not launch astronauts until 2028, a significant delay from earlier timelines. The agency indicated the vehicle may also require a new rocket for future crewed missions, reflecting ongoing technical and engineering challenges with the program.
